name: SoundCloud
author: y1ad
description: Plays songs from SoundCloud (full, free versions) and has its own page to search and play tracks that only exist on SoundCloud.
changelog: New: its own page (Extensions > SoundCloud > Open its page) to search SoundCloud and play what only exists there. Experimental: it plays only while the page is open.

welcome.message: SoundCloud gives the audio of the songs you play, when it has a close match. For what only exists on SoundCloud, open its page and search there.
steps: In Settings > Playback, put SoundCloud first in the audio order.
For SoundCloud-only tracks: Extensions > SoundCloud > Open its page.

actions.name: audio.source
actions.why: Plays each song's audio from SoundCloud

actions.name: network
actions.why: Searches SoundCloud and opens its audio streams

actions.why: A page to search SoundCloud and play its tracks

actions.why: Keeps the SoundCloud client ID it found

settings.label: How strict the match is
settings.description: How close a SoundCloud upload must be to the song (title, artist, length).

settings.label: Client ID (optional)
settings.description: Leave empty: it is looked up by itself.

settings.label: Look up the client ID again

es.description: Reproduce canciones desde SoundCloud (versiones completas y gratis) y tiene su propia página para buscar y reproducir pistas que solo existen en SoundCloud.
es.changelog: Nuevo: su propia página (Extensiones > SoundCloud > Abrir su página) para buscar en SoundCloud y reproducir lo que solo existe allá. Experimental: suena solo mientras la página está abierta.

welcome.message: SoundCloud pone el audio de las canciones que reproduces, cuando encuentra una coincidencia cercana. Para lo que solo existe en SoundCloud, abre su página y busca ahí.
steps: En Ajustes > Reproducción, pon SoundCloud primero en el orden de audio.
Para pistas solo de SoundCloud: Extensiones > SoundCloud > Abrir su página.
